title: StablecoinX Book Value per Share: June 30, 2026 10-Q
headline: What is StablecoinX's book value per share?
name: StablecoinX book value review
description: StablecoinX's June 30, 2026 book value was $8.92 per Class A share, with ENA carried at about $0.0702 a token. USDE closed Oct 8 at 1.43 times that figure.
imageAlt: Line chart per Class A share from June 30 to October 8, 2026. Token NAV per share, with ENA at its 4 pm price, rose from $8.92 to a high of $33.04 on September 25 and was $25.66 on October 8. USDE's close rose from $2.75, passed June 30 book value per share of $8.92 on September 18 and was $12.79 on October 8.
